name: actonce
description: Record AI device actions once, replay them deterministically.

scripts.ios:doctor: npm --prefix runtime/ios run build && node runtime/ios/dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.ios:compile-primitives: npm --prefix runtime/ios run build && node runtime/ios/dist/cli.js compile-primitives
scripts.ios:source: npm --prefix runtime/ios run build && node runtime/ios/dist/cli.js source
scripts.ios:run: npm --prefix runtime/ios run build && node runtime/ios/dist/cli.js run
scripts.replay:build: npm --prefix runtime/common run build && npm --prefix runtime/midscene-fallback run build
scripts.replay:test: npm --prefix runtime/common test && npm --prefix runtime/midscene-fallback test
scripts.macos:doctor: npm --prefix runtime/macos run build && node runtime/macos/dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.macos:compile-primitives: npm --prefix runtime/macos run build && node runtime/macos/dist/cli.js compile-primitives
scripts.macos:plan-observations: npm --prefix runtime/macos run build && node runtime/macos/dist/cli.js plan-observations
scripts.macos:validate-observations: npm --prefix runtime/macos run build && node runtime/macos/dist/cli.js validate-observations
scripts.macos:source: npm --prefix runtime/macos run build && node runtime/macos/dist/cli.js source
scripts.macos:run: npm --prefix runtime/macos run build && node runtime/macos/dist/cli.js run
scripts.benchmark:macos:lynxtron:reproduce: npm run benchmark:macos:lynxtron:prepare && npm run benchmark:macos:lynxtron
scripts.benchmark:macos:lynxtron:reproduce-suite: npm run benchmark:macos:lynxtron:prepare && npm run benchmark:macos:lynxtron:suite
